Timestamped redistribution/reach observations with platform sampling rules

Defined stale-information or coordination-failure outcomes

NASA documents Kepler-90i and Kepler-80g as ML-assisted discoveries; both are present in the current confirmed-planet archive.

GEBCO, Argo and CCHDO publish different reuse and citation conditions; data permission does not establish maritime ownership.

Join generator-hour SO2/NOx emissions to the relevant electricity dispatch assumptions.
Run or retrieve a validated atmospheric transport model, with receptor locations, meteorology, baseline and uncertainty; do not map total acidification as AI-caused.

Preserve sensitivity and false-positive rates with uncertainty; do not compare AUCs as patient outcomes.
Verify dataset reuse terms and the source’s handling of missing or nonbinary demographic records.

Use published project geometry with verified reuse; do not infer blanket ownership, consent or mining approval from a consultation notice.

blockers: Obtain an explicitly reusable dated route/landing-point dataset, or curate a bounded set of operator-confirmed routes with sourced geometry.
Verify active versus planned status and join dated outage/capacity observations.
Label connections as infrastructure context; only add AI access or bottleneck claims with independently measured service endpoints.

concepts.claim: Automated cruise-outbreak forecasting has retrospective evidence, but the located study uses mechanistic transmission models rather than an established AI intervention.
blockers: Identify a genuinely ML-based shipboard model and extract prospective or strictly out-of-time forecast dates, horizon, observed cases and baseline scores.
Preserve voyage-level denominators, underreporting and uncertainty.
Alternatively explicitly commission a non-AI automated-modelling reframe; do not relabel the existing mechanistic study as AI.

concepts.claim: Drone surveillance is deployed, but vendor detection claims and human observer trials do not provide a validated AI shark-safety performance table.
blockers: Extract identified model/version, sea conditions, shark species, true-event counts, misses and false alarms from an evaluated AI trial.
Separate human-assisted drone spotting from autonomous detection.
Do not turn detection accuracy into an estimate of swimmer safety without an outcome study.

concepts.claim: Public expanded earthquake catalogs exist, but catalog growth cannot automatically be attributed to AI or compared as changing seismic activity.
blockers: Retrieve the Cahuilla catalog with documented ML stage and source citation/reuse conditions.
Join a fixed-footprint conventional catalog over identical time and magnitude-completeness limits; preserve location errors.
If using raw events only, reframe as one reconstructed swarm and omit claims about worldwide detection improvement or seismic hazard.

concepts.claim: Latency measurements and cable routes can each be sourced, but a trustworthy join from a given AI request to a subsea route is not established.
blockers: Freeze a public measurement ID set with probe coordinates, target identity, timestamp and RTT distribution.
Distinguish propagation, network routing and server/inference latency; retain unknown physical path.
Only infer cable route with independent path evidence; otherwise present measured network latency as context with no cable attribution.

concepts.claim: AI aerosol-property retrieval exists, but source attribution under overlapping aerosol mixtures needs different ground truth.
blockers: Choose a named source-attribution model with held-out sites/times and independently measured aerosol composition labels.
Extract class-specific confusion matrices, sample counts, mixed-source treatment and uncertainty.
Keep satellite retrieval uncertainty separate from confidence in causal source attribution; do not infer sources from colour alone.

concepts.claim: Treaty-monitoring organizations discuss ML assistance, but a public independently checked event-detection benchmark has not been obtained.
blockers: Obtain an openly reusable benchmark with waveform/source provenance, analyst labels, train/test separation and false-alarm/miss rates.
Document human review and corroborating sensor modalities.
Represent uncertain signals as uncertain; do not infer a nuclear test, responsible state or treaty violation from an automated detector.

concepts.claim: Crop wild-relative collections are documented, but they cannot yet be joined to named AI breeding training sets with accession-level provenance.
blockers: Select one public breeding model with a versioned training accession list and explicit reuse.
Join taxon/accession identifiers to Crop Trust or genebank holdings; preserve unmatched IDs.
Add conservation status with observation dates; do not equate absence from a training release with species extinction.

concepts.claim: Argo offers reproducible open ocean profiles and ML-derived products, but a frozen current observing-coverage extraction has not been validated.
blockers: Download a specific monthly GDAC index/snapshot and retain DOI, profile date, position, sensor type and QC flags.
Define active observing coverage with a transparent time window and depth rule; distinguish unobserved from invalid or delayed data.
For a direct AI claim, join a named model’s documented training/validation profile list; otherwise label the map observing-system context.

concepts.claim: Forest alerts can support useful action, but the located intervention evidence bundles algorithms, training, incentives and enforcement.
blockers: Retrieve the Peru trial’s complete effect estimates, uncertainty, randomized units and outcome definitions from primary tables.
Package the alert-plus-community intervention as the treatment, not AI alone.
Add alert validation and intervention follow-up separately before proposing a globe about both confirmed detections and successful action.

concepts.claim: Earthquake early warning begins after rupture; no packaged prospective AI comparison supports a broader prediction claim.
blockers: Choose one AI detector and obtain prospective alert logs with event IDs, alert timestamps, shaking arrival, false alerts and missed events.
Compare against an operational baseline under the same geography, threshold and sensor availability.
Use warning lead time after rupture, not a claimed time before the earthquake begins.

concepts.claim: Automated asteroid discoveries are real, but the prominent HelioLinc3D example is an orbit-linking algorithm and cannot be labelled ML without evidence.

Extract completeness and false-positive rates by magnitude, sky region and observing cadence.
Keep orbital linking, machine-learning image detection and impact-risk assessment separate; no AI discovery-yield claim from an unlabelled algorithm.
